## Description

Uses Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to train a deep generative network that matches higher-order joint statistical moments of multi-asset return distributions for tail-risk simulation.

## Where it may fit

Non-Gaussian asset correlation regimes, fat-tailed joint returns, stress testing complex option portfolios.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Risk Management Groups, Multi-Asset Allocation Desks.

## Required data

Multivariate daily and intraday return matrices across equity, fixed income, and commodity universes.

## Caveats

Kernel bandwidth parameter selection in MMD significantly impacts the fidelity of tail moment matching.
